preconditions.description: n is the length of sequences a and b, and l and r are bounds for their elements.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(l <= x <= r for x in a)
preconditions.description: a is a sequence of length n with each element between l and r.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in p) and len(set(p)) == n
preconditions.description: p is a sequence of length n with distinct integers between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(b) == n and all(l <= x <= r for x in b))
postconditions.description: If a valid sequence b exists, output it as n space-separated integers within [l, r]; otherwise output '-1'.

postconditions.expression: stdout != '-1' and (lambda c: all(1 <= p[i] <= n and p[i] == sum(1 for x in c if x <= c[i]) for i in range(n)))(sorted([b[i] - a[i] for i in range(n)]))
postconditions.description: If b is output, then the compressed sequence of c = [b[i] - a[i] for i in range(n)] must match p, where c is sorted in ascending order.
